ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio with a distribution of approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels to 25% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white central regions across both lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated along the leading edges, distal tips, and trailing edges, with isolated low-intensity pixel clusters (spots) scattered within the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 48-52 degrees and significant bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (jagged peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge; includes a significant, deep semi-circular indentation (notched defect) on the upper-third of the right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex sweep trajectory transitioning into sharp, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white/grey pixel formations (barnacle colonization) concentrated heavily on the distal tips and intermittently along the leading edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed primarily on the right lobe, appearing as scratches that break the white pigmentation mapping.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant physical trauma indicated by a large, irregular missing section/indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive barnacle encrustation on both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Parallel linear scarring patterns on the inner right lobe and a prominent dark vertical streak near the central notch area.
